@'
#============================================================================
# pcie_dma.sdc -- Timing constraints for the PCIe DMA engine (Lattice Radiant)
#
# Port of quartus/pcie_dma.sdc. Same clock, same reset false path, same 1 ns
# I/O budget. Differences from the Quartus file:
#   * derive_clock_uncertainty is a TimeQuest command with no Radiant
#     equivalent and is dropped (no set_clock_uncertainty is applied).
#   * all_inputs / remove_from_collection are replaced by explicit port lists.
#     Only ports that exist after synthesis of SYS_IF="AXI4" are listed: the
#     inputs of the unselected SYS buses (avm_*, hrdata/hready/hresp) and the
#     unused axi_bid/axi_rid have no loads.
#============================================================================

# 125 MHz application clock (8 ns). Change to match the PCIe user clock.
create_clock -name clk -period 8.000 [get_ports clk]

# asynchronous, synchronously-deasserted reset: with RESET_SYNC=1 the false
# path is the asynchronous rst_n input into the reset_sync flops; the
# synchronized deassertion is then a normal timed path inside the clk domain.
set_false_path -from [get_ports rst_n]

# Conservative I/O budget: 1 ns for paths to/from the (virtual) bus ports.
set_input_delay -clock clk 1.0 [get_ports {csr_address[*] csr_read csr_write csr_writedata[*]}]
set_input_delay -clock clk 1.0 [get_ports {host_waitrequest host_readdata[*] host_readdatavalid host_response[*]}]
set_input_delay -clock clk 1.0 [get_ports {axi_awready axi_wready axi_bresp[*] axi_bvalid axi_arready axi_rdata[*] axi_rresp[*] axi_rlast axi_rvalid}]

set_output_delay -clock clk 1.0 [get_ports {csr_readdata[*] csr_readdatavalid csr_waitrequest}]
set_output_delay -clock clk 1.0 [get_ports {host_address[*] host_read host_write host_writedata[*] host_byteenable[*] host_burstcount[*]}]
set_output_delay -clock clk 1.0 [get_ports {axi_awid[*] axi_awaddr[*] axi_awlen[*] axi_awsize[*] axi_awburst[*] axi_awcache[*] axi_awprot[*] axi_awvalid}]
set_output_delay -clock clk 1.0 [get_ports {axi_wdata[*] axi_wstrb[*] axi_wlast axi_wvalid axi_bready}]
set_output_delay -clock clk 1.0 [get_ports {axi_arid[*] axi_araddr[*] axi_arlen[*] axi_arsize[*] axi_arburst[*] axi_arcache[*] axi_arprot[*] axi_arvalid axi_rready}]
set_output_delay -clock clk 1.0 [get_ports {irq sys_bus_error host_bus_error}]
'@ | Set-Content lattice/pcie_dma.sdc
@'
#============================================================================
# pcie_dma.pdc -- Post-synthesis physical constraints (Lattice Radiant)
#
# pcie_dma_top is an IP core with ~900 top-level port bits; the BG256 package
# cannot bond them out. Like quartus/virtual_pins.tcl, every port except
# clk/rst_n is made a Radiant Virtual I/O (terminated in a feedthrough LUT
# instead of a PIO). clk and rst_n stay real pins and are left unlocated
# (PAR chooses the sites); no pin locations are assigned.
#============================================================================
ldc_set_attribute {VIRTUAL_IO=TRUE} [get_ports {csr_*}]
ldc_set_attribute {VIRTUAL_IO=TRUE} [get_ports {host_*}]
ldc_set_attribute {VIRTUAL_IO=TRUE} [get_ports {avm_*}]
ldc_set_attribute {VIRTUAL_IO=TRUE} [get_ports {axi_*}]
ldc_set_attribute {VIRTUAL_IO=TRUE} [get_ports {haddr* hburst* hsize* htrans* hwrite hwdata* hrdata* hready hresp}]
ldc_set_attribute {VIRTUAL_IO=TRUE} [get_ports {irq sys_bus_error}]
'@ | Set-Content lattice/pcie_dma.pdc
@'
#============================================================================
# build.tcl -- Lattice Radiant flow for the PCIe DMA engine (Certus-NX)
#
#   cd lattice
#   D:\lscc\radiant\2026.1\bin\nt64\radiantc.exe build.tcl
#
# Creates a scratch project under lattice/build/, then runs Synplify Pro
# synthesis, map, place & route and static timing analysis for
#   top    : pcie_dma_top  (SYS_IF="AXI4", RESET_SYNC=1)
#   device : LFD2NX-40-8BG256C
#   clock  : clk, 125 MHz (pcie_dma.sdc)
# and copies the synthesis log, map report, PAR report and timing report to
# lattice/reports/.
#============================================================================
set here [file dirname [file normalize [info script]]]
set root [file dirname $here]
set proj pcie_dma
set impl impl_1
set bld  $here/build
set rpt  $here/reports

file delete -force $bld
file mkdir $bld
file mkdir $rpt
cd $bld

prj_create -name $proj -impl $impl -dev LFD2NX-40-8BG256C -synthesis synplify

# package first, then the same RTL set as quartus/pcie_dma.qsf (+ reset_sync)
foreach f {
    rtl/pkg/dma_pkg.sv
    rtl/core/dma_fifo.sv
    rtl/core/dma_arbiter.sv
    rtl/core/dma_csr.sv
    rtl/core/dma_descriptor_fetch.sv
    rtl/core/dma_data_mover.sv
    rtl/core/dma_engine_core.sv
    rtl/core/reset_sync.sv
    rtl/adapters/gmm_to_avalon.sv
    rtl/adapters/gmm_to_axi4.sv
    rtl/adapters/gmm_to_ahb.sv
    rtl/top/pcie_dma_top.sv
} {
    prj_add_source $root/$f
}
prj_add_source $here/pcie_dma.sdc
prj_add_source $here/pcie_dma.pdc

prj_set_impl_opt -impl $impl top pcie_dma_top
prj_set_impl_opt -impl $impl {include path} [list $root/rtl/pkg]
prj_set_impl_opt -impl $impl HDL_PARAM {SYS_IF="AXI4";RESET_SYNC=1}
prj_set_impl_opt -impl $impl stop_if_timing_error 0
prj_save

prj_run_synthesis
prj_run_map
prj_run_par

prj_save
prj_close

# collect reports
foreach {src dst} [list \
    $impl/${proj}_${impl}.srr      synthesis.srr \
    $impl/${proj}_${impl}.mrp      map.mrp \
    $impl/${proj}_${impl}.par      par.par \
    $impl/${proj}_${impl}.twr      timing.twr \
] {
    if {[file exists $bld/$src]} {
        file copy -force $bld/$src $rpt/$dst
    } else {
        puts "build.tcl: WARNING: missing report $src"
    }
}
'@ | Set-Content lattice/build.tcl
Set-Location lattice; & D:\lscc\radiant\2026.1\bin\nt64\radiantc.exe build.tcl *> build_console.txt; "rc=$LASTEXITCODE"; Set-Location ..; Get-Content lattice/build_console.txt | Select-Object -Last 40; Get-ChildItem lattice/build/impl_1 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | % Name

#============================================================================
# build.tcl -- Lattice Radiant flow for the PCIe DMA engine (Certus-NX)
#
#   cd lattice
#   D:\lscc\radiant\2026.1\bin\nt64\radiantc.exe build.tcl
#
# Creates a scratch project under lattice/build/, then runs Synplify Pro
# synthesis, map, place & route and static timing analysis for

#   device : LFD2NX-40-8BG256C
#   clock  : clk, 125 MHz (pcie_dma.sdc)
# and copies the synthesis log, map report, PAR report and timing report to
# lattice/reports/.
#============================================================================
set here [file dirname [file normalize [info script]]]
set root [file dirname $here]
set proj pcie_dma
set impl impl_1
set bld  $here/build
set rpt  $here/reports

file delete -force $bld
file mkdir $bld
file mkdir $rpt
cd $bld

prj_create -name $proj -impl $impl -dev LFD2NX-40-8BG256C -synthesis synplify

# package first, then the same RTL set as quartus/pcie_dma.qsf (+ reset_sync)
foreach f {
    rtl/pkg/dma_pkg.sv
    rtl/core/dma_fifo.sv
    rtl/core/dma_arbiter.sv
    rtl/core/dma_csr.sv
    rtl/core/dma_descriptor_fetch.sv
    rtl/core/dma_data_mover.sv
    rtl/core/dma_engine_core.sv
    rtl/core/reset_sync.sv
    rtl/adapters/gmm_to_avalon.sv
    rtl/adapters/gmm_to_axi4.sv
    rtl/adapters/gmm_to_ahb.sv
    rtl/top/pcie_dma_top.sv
} {

}

prj_add_source $here/pcie_dma.pdc

prj_set_impl_opt -impl $impl {include path} [list $root/rtl/pkg]

prj_set_impl_opt -impl $impl stop_if_timing_error 0
prj_save

prj_run_synthesis
prj_run_map
prj_run_par

prj_save
prj_close

foreach {src dst} [list \
    $impl/${proj}_${impl}.srr      synthesis.srr \
    $impl/${proj}_${impl}.mrp      map.mrp \
    $impl/${proj}_${impl}.par      par.par \
    $impl/${proj}_${impl}.twr      timing.twr \
] {
